I love my fridge. I love my through the door water and ice. I HATE changing the filter. Our fridge is now "old" (12 years makes it old, right?, LOL). And while I don't normally have issues finding the manufacturer filter at the local big box stores, this last time, they were out of them. Then I remembered, who shops in stores now? Hello Amazon prime!

As I was getting ready to cart the manufacturer brand, I saw this filter taunting me on the screen. Much cheaper and several reviews. I read through a bunch of reviews, and then decided to gamble with my family's lives and save a few dollars. When the filter arrived, I swapped our nasty old one out, and put this one in. I did fill a few more pitchers then I normally do, as some reviews stated it takes longer to get the filter dust, black/grey water to filter out then the original one. Honestly I didn't really find that to be true.

Here we are, several months into use, and so far none of my family members, or my cat have died. So I call that a win! Kidding aside, I honestly see no difference between this one and the manufacturer one we've used for 12 years. I guess I should have jumped ship and started using these years ago. The savings might have funded that vacation home in the Caribbean much sooner ;)

I ordered one of these back in January. We tried it; it fit but didn't dispense water, so I put it aside and we bought drinking water. Then we were hit with several bouts of flu and this got pushed faaaar down the "to do" list. I pulled it back out this week and checked the date - yep, we were well beyond Amazon's 30-day return deadline. 'Oh well', thought I, 'maybe I can find someone in Customer Service to help me get it to work.'

I emailed Refresh Customer Service not expecting much. My email was promptly returned with some suggestions. When those suggestions failed, the representative decided to just issue a refund!
" this must be a specific compatibility model with your fridge filter connection point. As you have already been without a filter now and need one, I have issued a full refund for your order and no return will be necessary just discard the filter."

They weren't required to do this, obviously, and I never asked. THIS is the standard of customer service (ahem East-West Herbs) that has made Amazon a top company.

My advice: try the filter. When the customer service is golden, you literally have nothing to lose!

I have just started using silicone lids and am totally convinced that silicone is the way to go!  I love the looks of this lid and the color is so pretty.  The design is very attractive.  I use my Pyrex baking pans all the time and have been using up so much aluminum foil and plastic wrap without ever getting a good seal.  This silicone suction lid provides the most air-tight seal possible and will keep food fresher for a long time.  I love that this can go into the freezer and will help to keep freezer burn and freezer smells out of the food!  I put it in the dishwasher as soon as I opened it, but it's so easy to clean right in your sink.  I've used it in the oven, and it's SO much easier that using aluminum foil to check what's cooking.  It  works great to keep food warm while getting ready to serve. The dimensions for this lid are given are in inches.  The bottom of my pan of the same size is in metrics: 33cm x 23 cm x 5 cm.  I hope that this conversion is helpful. You can see from the shadow,  in the picture of the large pan, that you can lift a pan right off of the counter.  The handle is easy to grasp. This lid is also able to be used on a smaller rectangular pan. My second picture shows it being used on an 11" x 7" x 1.5" pan.  The seal is just as great.  I was able to lift the pan more than 12 inches into the air! These lids are so amazing that I wish one was made for my slightly larger Pyrex pan.  I'm so impressed with these lids. This product is used primarily as a cover for a 13x9 rectangular bake pan. I really welcome the bakeware silicone cover I recently purchased from Amazon. Most 13x9 bake pans have no covers or poorly sealed covers. As a result, baked goods turn stale quickly. This product however, is made of high quality silicone and creates a tight seal on a metal 13x9” cake pan. My cake has lasted over a week in the refrigerator since I began using it.
I also enjoy the versatility of the rectangular cover since it has other uses as well, such as covering a baking lasagna casserole in the oven to keep the cheese on top from getting too brown.. It also fits some of my rectangular ceramic baking pans as well that are slightly smaller. It can also be used as an oven splatter guard over a square roasting pan, to keep fatty meats [such as chicken pieces] from splattering in the oven. It is therefore great for oven, stove or microwave use, as well as a sealed storage cover. As I use it more, I am sure I will find other uses for it. Definitely a great high quality multi-purpose kitchen tool worth having!

I wanted to have something reusable so that I did not have to use foil all the time. This product is perfect! I just received it and so far it is just what I needed. It is much stronger and more well made than I had expected. It did not “sag” into the dish. I used it to cover an oval shaped Le Creuset casserole dish and it worked perfectly even though the cover is rectangular. I was able to lift the cover off easily to see the dish, more easily than foil! It was very easy to take off for the last 15 minutes of baking to let the casserole brown. Cleaning was a breeze. I did not need to put it in the dishwasher as I just took a sponge and wiped it clean.  It also seals so although I have not tried using it in the refrigerator, I think it will come in very handy for that purpose as well. I also think it is very versitile and will fit many of my pans and bake ware dishes. The only thing I am not expecting to be perfect is the color. While I like the light blue color, I think over time with use it might become stained. I am not very concerned about that though as it would only be stained on the bottom, or the portion that is closest to the food.

Because they are silicone and can withstand high temperatures, you can use them in the oven, on top of your pots and pans while cooking, and just put them on top of your dishes when you have left-overs and put them in the fridge!.
